Additionally, you can specify the image to use and the command to run inside the container [Source 1]. The `docker run` command offers several flags to customize container behavior, including the `-p` flag for port mapping [Source 6]. 

It's also worth noting that you can use the `-P` flag to publish all exposed ports of the container to random ports on the host [Source 5], but this is not the same as specifying a specific port mapping with the `-p` flag [Source 8]. 

In summary, to run a container in detached mode with a specific port mapping, you can use the `docker run -dp` command with the desired port mapping, such as `docker run -dp 127.0.0.1:3000:3000` [Source 1].
